en: There's no end to this.{ATTENTE}
The clock's ticking. If we don't stop this{SAUT}at some point, we might be in trouble.{ATTENTE}
Just being around treasure boxes makes me,{SAUT}like, totally happy!{ATTENTE}
After so many battles together, I have a{SAUT}higher opinion of you. You're strong.{ATTENTE}
Anyway... I'm only putting out feelers,{SAUT}but once we defeat the Snow Queen...{ATTENTE}
Would you mind coming along to rescue{SAUT}Masao? More manpower can hardly hurt.{ATTENTE}
I won't force you... just consider it.{ATTENTE}
Treasure boxes! What could be greater!?{SAUT}Man! Treasure boxes!{ATTENTE}
Everyone knows what they are, but how{SAUT}many have actually touched a real one!?{ATTENTE}
Please do keep our time limitations{SAUT}in mind.{ATTENTE}
{FERME}> Open the box?{ATTENTE}
I hope Ms. Saeko's okay... Dammit...{SAUT}We need to hurry this up.{ATTENTE}
This totally sucks! What am I gonna do{SAUT}without a Persona!?{ATTENTE}
We never previously realized the existence{SAUT}of Personas...{ATTENTE}
But I now realize how taxing it can be{SAUT}when one suddenly loses it.{ATTENTE}
Damn! Fighting without a Persona?{ATTENTE}
This tower has really strong monsters{SAUT}in it, too! This is no joke!{ATTENTE}
It seems that if you transgress in some{SAUT}way while in this tower...{ATTENTE}
There is a rule that you will pay with{SAUT}your "life."{ATTENTE}
But in our case, it seems we'll lose our{SAUT}Personas instead of our lives.{ATTENTE}
Not that it matters, but the treasure{SAUT}boxes in this tower are shaped funny.{ATTENTE}
I'm hungry... Do any of these treasure{SAUT}boxes have, like, food in 'em?{ATTENTE}
Supplies are only meaningful if you put{SAUT}them to use.{ATTENTE}
We must take care to ensure that they{SAUT}don't end up being useless.{ATTENTE}
Even if we had more time, it still{SAUT}wouldn't be enough.{ATTENTE}
This "Eternal Night" thingy could happen{SAUT}any second... What a drag.{ATTENTE}
Eternal Night...{ATTENTE}
What would that world be like? Despite my{SAUT}curiosity, I dread it...{ATTENTE}
Take care on your journey, young ones...。{ATTENTE}
fr: Prenez soin de vous, jeunes gens...。{ATTENTE}
